# Isaiah Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**9:2** The-people ha-am who-walk ha-holkhim in-the-darkness ba-choshekh have-seen ra'u a-great gadol light or; those-who-dwell yoshevei in-the-land of-the-shadow-of-death tsalmavvet — light or has-shone nagah upon-them alehem.

**9:6** For a-child yeled is-born yullad to-us, a-son ben is-given nittan to-us, and-the-government ha-misrah will-be upon his-shoulder shikhmo; and-his-name shemo will-be-called vayyiqra Wonderful pele Counselor yo'ets, Mighty gibbor God El, Everlasting ad Father avi, Prince sar of-Peace shalom.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 9 — "For to Us a Child Is Born" — part of First Isaiah (chs.1-39), rooted in the 8th-century BCE Assyrian crisis. The chapter contributes to Isaiah's overarching vision: YHWH as the Holy One of Israel who judges his people but promises ultimate restoration.

---

Minor register disagreements resolved through standard SOPHIA consensus process.
